title: Manyhands JSON v1 host replacement data
description: The data of a prepare envelope of host approve that is refused as host_replacement_required: the host has a pin, and a pin is changed by host replace and by nothing else. With the host.replace action the envelope offers, this is what that request is formed from: pinned_fingerprint is its old fingerprint, and algorithm and fingerprint are its key. A prepare connects to nothing, so no key the host presents is reported.

algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the refused request named.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the refused request named: SHA256: and the digest of the public key, as a pin holds it.

pinned_algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the host is pinned to now.

pinned_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the host is pinned to now: what host replace is given as the old fingerprint.
